title: knowltonia helleborifolia
intro: Knowltonia helleborifolia, commonly known as the Himalayan Barberry, is a plant species in the family Berberidaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Knowltonia helleborifolia include acting as an immunomodulator, antimicrobial agent, and cardiotonic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
